\"That's not what I asked.\"

She looked at him. Marcus had been her paralegal for six years. \"Already started the notice in the car.\"

The petition to lodge took shape on his screen in the careful, almost liturgical language of probate, language whose function was to flatten extraordinary domestic events into procedural inevitabilities. The Decedent did execute. The said instrument is herewi

house is now governed by an instrument that reflects, by every indication available to me, the actual final intent of the decedent. \"Neither do I.\"

Tomorrow you are going to spend the morning in that dining room mediating a fair-market appraisal among three people who an hour ago discovered they own a house together, and you are going to need to be a person and not a function when you do it. Go.\"

She went.
"""
